name: moonshine
description: Create interactive technical explanations inspired by Distill.pub

interface.shortDescription: Distill complex ideas into interactive articles
interface.longDescription: Moonshine guides you through writing self-contained, Distill-style interactive technical explanations. It includes editorial process guidance, a D3 v7 visualization reference, an HTML scaffold for single-file articles, and an optional Vite + React template for structured projects.
defaultPrompt: Help me write an interactive explanation of a concept
Distill this idea into a Distill-style article
Scaffold a moonshine article with React figures
